label: Production discontinued or paused without prominent disclosure
description: A specific model year or trim is no longer in production, but the manufacturer continues to operate the marketing site, configurator, or comparison materials as if it were a current product. Buyers researching the vehicle do not encounter clear notice. The next-generation product, which differs substantially, is positioned as a replacement.
regulatory_basis: No specific regulation. State lemon-law and dealer-disclosure statutes vary; some require dealers (not manufacturers) to disclose discontinuation in writing.
consumer_harm: Resale value, parts availability, and warranty support are all affected by discontinuation. Buyers comparing to current alternatives are using stale information.
